subject: Syndicate Accelerator — promo voucher eligibility and activation
messages:
From: Kelly Tran <kelly@syndicateaccelerator.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-20T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Syndicate Accelerator — promo voucher availability for Dec cohort

Hi Mina,

Hope you’re well — we’re putting together our December cohort (Dec 7–21) and Syndicate is lining up a small group of startups for an LLM-focused track. We had a great pilot with Redwood earlier this year and want to offer a vendor credit to one cohort slot to reduce friction for teams trying Redwood for the first time.

Quick questions:
- Do you have partner-sourced marketplace vouchers or promo credit we can apply to new trial accounts for cohort companies?
- If yes, what are the usual per-account limits and expiry windows (30/60/90 days)?
- Any eligibility checklist we should fill out (POC plan, logo, mutual action plan)?

I attached a short cohort scope and the grant request form for context. If it helps, Ava (cc’d) is the program lead and can join a quick 20-min call.

Thanks — Kelly
Kelly Tran
Partnerships Manager, Syndicate Accelerator
kelly@syndicateaccelerator.com
+1 415-555-0123

Attachments: Syndicate_Cohort_Scope.pdf, grant_request_form.docx
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Kelly Tran <kelly@syndicateaccelerator.com>
Date: 2026-11-20T11:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Syndicate Accelerator — promo voucher availability for Dec cohort

Hi Kelly — great to hear from you and thanks for the materials. We’d love to support the cohort. High level: yes, we can route partner-funded marketplace vouchers to cohort accounts; typical pilot allocations are 5k–15k tokens (or equivalent $ value) per account with 60–90 day expiry depending on the program.

Before I lock anything down I have a couple of quick asks so I can route to the Partner Credits team:
- Confirm number of startups that would need vouchers and any per-account cap you prefer (we can do tiered allocations).
- Confirm whether these are marketplace entitlements (partner pays Redwood via marketplace) or Syndicate wants Redwood to bill directly and we issue credits.
- Any compliance or data residency notes for cohort workloads (likely low-risk dev/test but worth flagging).

If you’re good, I’ll open a partner credit intake and cc Sales Ops to get budget and activation flow (DocuSign or marketplace redemption link). I can also propose a standard activation page + one-click voucher redemption for cohort participants.

Available for a quick 20-min today 2–3pm PST if that helps — otherwise Monday works.

Best,
Mina Haddad
Partner Programs, Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwood.com

---

> Hope you’re well — we’re putting together our December cohort...
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>

Cc: 
Date: 2026-11-20T13:41:00-08:00
Subject: Fwd: Syndicate Accelerator — promo voucher availability for Dec cohort

Team — forwarding a request from Syndicate. They want partner-sourced vouchers for ~10 cohort startups (Dec 7 start). Asking about per-account caps and activation mechanics. Attachments included.

Preliminary asks:
- Marissa: can we do a 10k token (~$500) voucher per account for up to 10 startups under a partner-funded voucher flow? This would be charged to the Partner Credits pool.
- Ben: can you confirm the marketplace vs credit issuance path? If marketplace, we need partner onboarding + entitlement SKUs; if credit issuance, scope for a one-off voucher generation.
- Marcus: any objections from compliance on short-term trial credits for cohorts (no production data expected)?

If we greenlight, I’ll send Syndicate a redemption URL + short T&Cs (90-day expiry recommended). They need the paperwork by Nov 25 to notify startups.

Thanks — Mina

Attachments: Syndicate_Cohort_Scope.pdf, grant_request_form.docx
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-21T10:22:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Syndicate Accelerator — promo voucher availability for Dec cohort

Mina — sounds fine to me. Approve 10 accounts x 10k tokens each (DEAL-7892). 90-day expiry is acceptable for accelerator trials.

Ben — please confirm the flow: if Syndicate will pay via marketplace listing we can set up the entitlement today and generate redemption codes; if they want Redwood to invoice and issue credits, need to route to Finance for one-off credit allocation (we have buffer but would prefer marketplace).

Marcus — no compliance red flags from my side for non-prod workloads, but please confirm simple AUP (no PHI, no regulated PII) on the intake form.

If Ben confirms marketplace, Mina — I’ll draft the partner terms for the cohort and include standard marketplace redemption instructions.

Marissa Cole
Head of Partner Programs, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Kelly Tran <kelly@syndicateaccelerator.com>, Ava Patel <ava.p@syndicateaccelerator.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-23T08:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Syndicate Accelerator — promo voucher availability for Dec cohort

Hi Kelly / Ava — great news: we can support 10 vouchers at 10k tokens each with 90-day expiry.

Next steps:
1) Kelly: confirm whether Syndicate will purchase via the marketplace entitlement (preferred) or if you need Redwood to invoice and we issue credits.
2) If marketplace: I’ll send an entitlements link and a redemption URL you can provide to startups. If invoice: Ben will send a one-off invoice and we’ll push codes after payment clears.
3) Sign the partner cohort terms (link): https://www.docusign.com/prepare/ABC-7890. I’ve cc’d Marissa and Ben for approvals.

We’ll include simple AUP checkbox on the redemption page (no PHI/regulatory data). Let me know if you want a short co-branded welcome email template for startups — we can provide that.

Best,
Mina Haddad
Partner Programs, Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwood.com
